requirement_text:
The LRU software PSR Harmonizing data resides in the PSR.  The PSR Harmonizing data shall contain the following information:
Harmonize_SFC_PSR
Harmonize_Offset_PSR
Config_LRU_PSR
Asset_ID_PSR
Upper_Limit_LRU_PSR
Lower_Limit_LRU_PSR
CRC_PSR
Var_ID_PSR
Software/Firmware Version (aka. Label Version)
NOTE: Var_ID_PSR and Label Version are programmed into PSR by Provider Production team in accordance with the instructions in section 7.17 of the Acceptance Test Procedure (506500T).
Req Type: Decomposed | Safety Impact: No | Safety Rationale: This is a detailed implementation requirement.

After performing the signal initializations in LRUSWRS-1004, the LRU software shall transmit the following IVT response values over STL_Bus:
IVT_Receipt_Envelope = 0
IVT_Receipt_Content = 0
Req Type: Verbatim | Safety Impact: No | Safety Rationale: This is a detailed implementation requirement.

While IVT_Mode_ModeLgc is True, the LRU software shall enter Harmonizing mode upon the following condition:
Harmonizing_Active_STL is True AND remains True for 10 consecutive STL frames
Notes:
1) Harmonizing_Active_STL is defined in Table 1208.
2) IVT_Mode_ModeLgc is defined in LRUSWRS-1010.
Req Type: Decomposed | Safety Impact: No | Safety Rationale: This is a detailed implementation requirement.

Upon entry to Harmonizing mode, the LRU software shall overwrite the following Harmonizing parameters in PSR and in RAM with the values defined below:
Harmonize_Offset_PSR =  Harmonize_Offset_Default
Harmonize_SFC_PSR =  Harmonize_SFC_Default
Upper_Limit_LRU_PSR = Upper_Limit_LRU_Default
Lower_Limit_LRU_PSR = Lower_Limit_LRU_Default
Config_LRU_PSR = 0
Asset_ID_PSR = 0
Harmonize_Offset_ISM = Harmonize_Offset_Default
K_Harmonize_ISM = Harmonize_SFC_Default
Upper_Limit_LRU = Upper_Limit_LRU_Default
Lower_Limit_LRU =  Lower_Limit_LRU_Default
LRU_Harmonizing_Needed_PIVT = True
Notes:
1. Harmonize_Offset_Default, Harmonize_SFC_Default, Upper_Limit_LRU_Default, and Lower_Limit_LRU_Default are dependent on the LRU location.
2. PSR Harmonizing default values are defined in Table 10695, Rev C (for ATYPE-1 and ATYPE-2) and Table 106939, Rev B (for ATYPE-3).
Req Type: Decomposed | Safety Impact: No | Safety Rationale: This is a detailed implementation requirement.

After performing the initializations in LRUSWRS-1004 and applying the default values per LRUSWRS-1005, the LRU software shall transmit Harmonizing Needed on STL_Bus as follows:
IVT_Receipt_Envelope = 0x0011
IVT_Receipt_Content: LRU_Harmonizing_Needed_PIVT = True
Note:
LRU_Harmonizing_Needed_PIVT is defined in Table 1007.
Req Type: Decomposed | Safety Impact: No | Safety Rationale: This is a detailed implementation requirement.

The LRU software shall initialize the signals listed below when the following condition is True:
IVT_Mode_ModeLgc is True AND Harmonizing_Active_STL transitions to True
Contract_Stop_Collection_Complete = False
Expand_Stop_Collection_Complete = False
VOID_Collection_Complete = False (Primary Surface Only)
Harmonizing_Complete = False
Harmonizing_Failed = False
Act_Disp_Range_Contract_Fault = False
Act_Disp_Range_Expand_Fault = False
Act_Disp_Range_VOID_Fault = False (Primary Surface Only)
Note: For Spoiler surface, VOID point Harmonizing does not apply; therefore, VOID_Collection_Complete and Act_Disp_Range_VOID_Fault are N/A.
Req Type: Verbatim | Safety Impact: No | Safety Rationale: This is a detailed implementation requirement.

The electronic Harmonizing sequence for both Primary and Spoiler surface types are defined in the table below.  The prerequisite condition for execution of this Harmonizing sequence is that Harmonizing mode (LRUSWRS-1003) must be active.  The steps occur in blocks, 1 to 5, 6 to 10, 11 to 15, followed by 16 to 35.  The first three blocks are started by LRU_2 messages and can occur in any order. The last block occurs automatically after all three of the other blocks are completed.  Not all steps are applicable to both surface types.  The block steps not applicable to both surface types are noted following the requirement.
The LRU software shall implement the electronic Harmonizing sequence as shown in Table 1001.

Notes:  1) Harmonizing_Failed is defined in Table 1007.  2) IVT_Receipt_Content is an accummulation of all applicable Harmonizing status Bits. 3) Not applicable to LRU_3 and LRU_4. | 9210

Note: Not applicable to LRU_3 and LRU_4. | 9891
Table Row: 17 | For LRU_3 and LRU_4, set Spoiler_Harmonize_Calc to True if the following condition is True: Act_Disp_Range_Contract_Fault = False AND Act_Disp_Range_Expand_Fault = False AND Contract_Stop_Collection_Complete = True AND Expand_Stop_Collection_Complete = True. Note: Not applicable to primary surfaces. | 9892
Table Row: 18 | If Spoiler_Harmonize_Calc is True then compute  K_Harmonize_New  = Max_Stroke / [Act_Disp_Raw_Avg_Expand  -  Act_Disp_Raw_Avg_Contract]. where Max_Stroke is defined in:   Table 1020, Rev A: ATYPE-1 & ATYPE-2 LRU Harmonizing Max Strokes   Table 1021, Rev A: ATYPE-3 LRU Harmonizing Max Strokes | 9176

The value of Harmonize_Offset_Default is defined as a function of Profile_Id in:   Table 10695, Rev C: ATYPE-1 & ATYPE-2 LVDT Default Harmonizing Parameters  Table 106939, Rev B: ATYPE-3 LVDT Default Harmonizing Parameters Note: Not applicable to Primary Surfaces. | 6137

K_Harmonize_New  = (LRU_2_Act_Disp_Raw_Avg_Expand - LRU_2_Act_Disp_Raw_Avg_Contract)                                /(Act_Disp_Raw_Avg_Expand - Act_Disp_Raw_Avg_Contract). Note: Applicable to Elevator or Aileron Surfaces only. | 9212

The value of Contract_Error is defined in :  Table 10695, Rev C: ATYPE-1 & ATYPE-2 LVDT Default Harmonizing Parameters  Table 106939, Rev B: ATYPE-3 LVDT Default Harmonizing Parameters | 10915
Table Row: 24 | If LRU-3/4, calculate Upper_Limit_LRU_PSR_New and Lower_Limit_LRU_PSR_New to the fixed values as follows:   Upper_Limit_LRU_PSR_New = Upper_Limit_Harmonized   Lower_Limit_LRU_PSR_New = Lower_Limit_Harmonized    The value of Upper_Limit_Harmonized and Lower_Limit_Harmonized are as a function of Profile_Id in:  Table 1020, Rev A: ATYPE-1 & ATYPE-2 LRU Harmonizing Max Strokes  Table 1021, Rev A: ATYPE-3 LRU Harmonizing Max Strokes Note: Applicable only to Spoiler surfaces. | 10916
Table Row: 25 | If LRU-7, calculate Lower_Limit_LRU_PSR_New using the following equation:   Lower_Limit_LRU_PSR_New = Lower_Limit_Harmonized  The value of Lower_Limit_Harmonized is defined as a function of Profile_Id in:  Table 1020, Rev A: ATYPE-1 & ATYPE-2 LRU Harmonizing Max Strokes  Table 1021, Rev A: ATYPE-3 LRU Harmonizing Max Strokes Note: Applicable only to Rudder. | 10917

The value of Expand_Error is defined as a function of Profile_Id in: :   Table 10695, Rev C: ATYPE-1 & ATYPE-2 LVDT Default Harmonizing Parameters  Table 106939, Rev B: ATYPE-3 LVDT Default Harmonizing Parameters Note: Applicable only to Ailerons and Elevators. | 10918
Table Row: 27 | If LRU-7, calculate Upper_Limit_LRU_PSR_New using the following equation:   Upper_Limit_LRU_PSR_New = Upper_Limit_Harmonized The value of Upper_Limit_Harmonized is defined as a function of Profile_Id in:   Table 1020, Rev A: ATYPE-1 & ATYPE-2 LRU Harmonizing Max Strokes  Table 1021, Rev A: ATYPE-3 LRU Harmonizing Max Strokes Note: Applicable only to Rudder. | 10921
Table Row: 28 | Store new LRU Harmonizing parameters in PSR as follows:   Harmonize_SFC_PSR = K_Harmonize_New  Harmonize_Offset_PSR = Harmonize_Offset_New  Asset_ID_PSR = Asset_ID_STL  Config_LRU_PSR = Profile_ID_Disc_Dbnce_Init  Lower_Limit_LRU_PSR = Lower_Limit_LRU_PSR_New  Upper_Limit_LRU_PSR = Upper_Limit_LRU_PSR_New  CRC_PSR = CRC for data above | 9215
Table Row: 29 | The LRU reads back the data stored in PSR and re-computes the CRC of the PSR Harmonizing parameters. | 9225

Table Row: 31 | If CRC check as defined in Step above fails, the LRU software sets Harmonizing_PSR_Data_Fault to True, else set  Harmonizing_PSR_Data_Fault to False. | 9224
Table Row: 32 | If Harmonizing_PSR_Data_Fault transitions to True, then perform the following:  create a Harmonizing_PSR_Data_Fault entry in the Fault_History_Table_PSR   report Harmonizing Failed to the LRU_2 on STL_Bus:  IVT_Receipt_Envelope=0x0017, IVT_Receipt_Content: Harmonizing_Failed = True. Note: Harmonizing_Failed is defined in Table 1007. | 9249
Table Row: 33 | Set the following to False if Harmonizing_PSR_Data_Fault is False.   LRU_Harmonizing_Needed_PIVT   Corrupt_PSR_Harmonizing_CIP_Fault_Init. | 9894

Note: These parameters are used in the position control state.  Therefore, one might have to enter the position control state to see the updates. | 9247

IVT_Receipt_Envelope = 0x0012, IVT_Receipt_Content = Config_LRU_PSR (LRU Harmonizing Location and Asset type)  IVT_Receipt_Envelope = 0x0013, IVT_Receipt_Content = Asset_ID_PSR   IVT_Receipt_Envelope = 0x0014, IVT_Receipt_Content = Harmonizing_SFC_PSR  IVT_Receipt_Envelope = 0x0015, IVT_Receipt_Content = Harmonizing_Offset_PSR  IVT_Receipt_Envelope = 0x0018, IVT_Receipt_Content = Lower_Limit_LRU_PSR  IVT_Receipt_Envelope = 0x0019, IVT_Receipt_Content = Upper_Limit_LRU_PSR  IVT_Receipt_Envelope = 0x0017, IVT_Receipt_Content: Harmonizing_Complete = True Note: All IVT Response Codes and Data IVT formats are defined in Table 1007. | 9239

Sample 50 frames (25 ms) of Act_Disp_Raw (in) and average them when the following condition is True: IVT_Command_ISM = 0x0020, IVT_CmdData_ISM: Harmonize_VOID_STL = True. Note: Act_Disp_Raw is depicted Figure 4436 and Harmonize_VOID_STL is defined in Table 1008.  Not applicable to LRU_3 and LRU_4.

Compute  Act_Disp_Raw_Avg_VOID while commanded to the VOID position as follows: [the average of Act_Disp_Raw from Step above] * Harmonize_SFC_Default + Harmonize_Offset_Default.The values of Harmonize_SFC_Default and Harmonize_Offset_Default are defined as a function of Profile_Id in:   Table 10695, Rev C: ATYPE-1 & ATYPE-2 LVDT Default Harmonizing Parameters  Table 106939, Rev B: ATYPE-3 LVDT Default Harmonizing Parameters  Set VOID_Collection_Complete = True Note:  Not applicable to LRU_3 and LRU_4.

Set Act_Disp_Range_VOID_Fault to True if Act_Disp_Raw_Avg_VOID (in) is not within the following range:  Table 1018, Rev A ATYPE-1 & ATYPE-2 VOID Harmonizing Range  Table 1019, Rev NC ATYPE-3 VOID Harmonizing Range Else set Act_Disp_Range_VOID_Fault to False. Note: Not applicable to LRU_3 and LRU_4.

Set and transmit IVT Response data on STL_Bus as follows: IVT_Receipt_Envelope = 0x0017,  IVT_Receipt_Content: VOID_Collection_Complete = True,  Notes:  1) VOID_Collection_Complete is defined in Table 1007. 2) IVT_Receipt_Content is an accummulation of all applicable Harmonizing status Bits. 3) Not applicable to LRU_3 and LRU_4.

If Act_Disp_Range_VOID_Fault is True, set and transmit IVT Response data on STL_Bus as follows: IVT_Receipt_Envelope = 0x0017,   IVT_Receipt_Content: Harmonizing_Failed = True, else IVT_Receipt_Envelope = 0x0017,   IVT_Receipt_Content: Harmonizing_Failed = False.  Notes:  1) Harmonizing_Failed is defined in Table 1007.  2) IVT_Receipt_Content is an accummulation of all applicable Harmonizing status Bits. 3) Not applicable to LRU_3 and LRU_4.

If Act_Disp_Range_VOID_Fault transitions to True, create an entry in the Fault_History_Table_PSR. Notes: 1) Not applicable to LRU_3 and LRU_4. 2) This is the only entry of this fault in the Fault_History_Table_PSR for the current power-on session.

The LRU_2 asserts both Harmonizing Active and IVT Active, and transmits its own Average Expand and Contract LVDT Position on the STL Bus using IVT_Command_ISM and IVT_CmdData_ISM as follows:  IVT_Active_STL = True  Harmonizing_Active_STL = True  IVT_Command_ISM, IVT_CmdData_ISM: LRU_2_Act_Disp_Raw_Avg_Contract_STL  IVT_Command_ISM, IVT_CmdData_ISM: LRU_2_Act_Disp_Raw_Avg_Expand_STL.

Set Primary_Harmonize_Calc to True when the following condition is True: Act_Disp_Range_VOID_Fault = False  AND Act_Disp_Range_Contract_Fault = False AND Act_Disp_Range_Expand_Fault = False AND Contract_Stop_Collection_Complete = True AND Expand_Stop_Collection_Complete = True AND VOID_Collection_Complete = True. Note: Not applicable to LRU_3 and LRU_4.

For LRU_3 and LRU_4, set Spoiler_Harmonize_Calc to True if the following condition is True: Act_Disp_Range_Contract_Fault = False AND Act_Disp_Range_Expand_Fault = False AND Contract_Stop_Collection_Complete = True AND Expand_Stop_Collection_Complete = True. Note: Not applicable to primary surfaces.

If Spoiler_Harmonize_Calc is True then compute  K_Harmonize_New  = Max_Stroke / [Act_Disp_Raw_Avg_Expand  -  Act_Disp_Raw_Avg_Contract]. where Max_Stroke is defined in:   Table 1020, Rev A: ATYPE-1 & ATYPE-2 LRU Harmonizing Max Strokes   Table 1021, Rev A: ATYPE-3 LRU Harmonizing Max Strokes

If Spoiler_Harmonize_Calc is True, then calculate the new LVDT Harmonizing Offset as follows:  Harmonize_Offset_New  =  (Harmonize_Offset_Default - Act_Disp_Raw_Avg_Contract)  * K_Harmonize_New.  The value of Harmonize_Offset_Default is defined as a function of Profile_Id in:   Table 10695, Rev C: ATYPE-1 & ATYPE-2 LVDT Default Harmonizing Parameters  Table 106939, Rev B: ATYPE-3 LVDT Default Harmonizing Parameters Note: Not applicable to Primary Surfaces.

Calculate the new LVDT Harmonizing Gain when Primary_Harmonize_Calc is True AND Profile_Id is any of the following:  LRU_1,  LRU_2,  LRU_5,   LRU_6. K_Harmonize_New  = (LRU_2_Act_Disp_Raw_Avg_Expand - LRU_2_Act_Disp_Raw_Avg_Contract)                                /(Act_Disp_Raw_Avg_Expand - Act_Disp_Raw_Avg_Contract). Note: Applicable to Elevator or Aileron Surfaces only.

Calculate the new LVDT Harmonizing Gain when Primary_Harmonize_Calc is True AND Profile_Id = LRU_7 as follows: K_Harmonize_New  =  Max_Stroke / [Act_Disp_Raw_Avg_Expand (in) – Act_Disp_Raw_Avg_Contract (in)]. where Max_Stroke is defined as a function of Profile_Id in:  Table 1020, Rev A: ATYPE-1 & ATYPE-2 LRU Harmonizing Max Strokes  Table 1021, Rev A: ATYPE-3 LRU Harmonizing Max Strokes Note: Applicable to LRU_7 (Rudder) only.

Calculate the new LVDT Harmonizing Offset as follows when Primary_Harmonize_Calc is True: Harmonize_Offset_New  = (Harmonize_Offset_Default - Act_Disp_Raw_Avg_VOID)  * K_Harmonize_New. The value of Harmonize_Offset_Default is defined as a function of Profile_Id in:   Table 10695, Rev C: ATYPE-1 & ATYPE-2 LVDT Default Harmonizing Parameters  Table 106939, Rev B: ATYPE-3 LVDT Default Harmonizing Parameters Note:   Not applicable to OB Spoiler Surfaces.

If LRU-1/2/5/6, calculate Lower_Limit_LRU_PSR_New when Primary_Harmonize_Calc by the following equation: Lower_Limit_LRU_PSR_New =  Act_Disp_Raw_Avg_Contract + Contract_Error. The value of Contract_Error is defined in :  Table 10695, Rev C: ATYPE-1 & ATYPE-2 LVDT Default Harmonizing Parameters  Table 106939, Rev B: ATYPE-3 LVDT Default Harmonizing Parameters

If LRU-3/4, calculate Upper_Limit_LRU_PSR_New and Lower_Limit_LRU_PSR_New to the fixed values as follows:   Upper_Limit_LRU_PSR_New = Upper_Limit_Harmonized   Lower_Limit_LRU_PSR_New = Lower_Limit_Harmonized    The value of Upper_Limit_Harmonized and Lower_Limit_Harmonized are as a function of Profile_Id in:  Table 1020, Rev A: ATYPE-1 & ATYPE-2 LRU Harmonizing Max Strokes  Table 1021, Rev A: ATYPE-3 LRU Harmonizing Max Strokes Note: Applicable only to Spoiler surfaces.

If LRU-7, calculate Lower_Limit_LRU_PSR_New using the following equation:   Lower_Limit_LRU_PSR_New = Lower_Limit_Harmonized  The value of Lower_Limit_Harmonized is defined as a function of Profile_Id in:  Table 1020, Rev A: ATYPE-1 & ATYPE-2 LRU Harmonizing Max Strokes  Table 1021, Rev A: ATYPE-3 LRU Harmonizing Max Strokes Note: Applicable only to Rudder.

If LRU-1/2/5/6, calculate Upper_Limit_LRU_PSR_New using the following equation:   Upper_Limit_LRU_PSR_New =  Act_Disp_Raw_Avg_Expand – Expand_Error.  The value of Expand_Error is defined as a function of Profile_Id in: :   Table 10695, Rev C: ATYPE-1 & ATYPE-2 LVDT Default Harmonizing Parameters  Table 106939, Rev B: ATYPE-3 LVDT Default Harmonizing Parameters Note: Applicable only to Ailerons and Elevators.

If LRU-7, calculate Upper_Limit_LRU_PSR_New using the following equation:   Upper_Limit_LRU_PSR_New = Upper_Limit_Harmonized The value of Upper_Limit_Harmonized is defined as a function of Profile_Id in:   Table 1020, Rev A: ATYPE-1 & ATYPE-2 LRU Harmonizing Max Strokes  Table 1021, Rev A: ATYPE-3 LRU Harmonizing Max Strokes Note: Applicable only to Rudder.

Store new LRU Harmonizing parameters in PSR as follows:   Harmonize_SFC_PSR = K_Harmonize_New  Harmonize_Offset_PSR = Harmonize_Offset_New  Asset_ID_PSR = Asset_ID_STL  Config_LRU_PSR = Profile_ID_Disc_Dbnce_Init  Lower_Limit_LRU_PSR = Lower_Limit_LRU_PSR_New  Upper_Limit_LRU_PSR = Upper_Limit_LRU_PSR_New  CRC_PSR = CRC for data above
The LRU reads back the data stored in PSR and re-computes the CRC of the PSR Harmonizing parameters.

Perform a CRC check of the following Harmonizing parameters set in PSR to verify it is not corrupted:  Harmonize_Offset_PSR  Harmonize_SFC_PSR  Asset_ID_PSR  Config_LRU_PSR  Lower_Limit_LRU_PSR  Upper_Limit_LRU_PSR.
If CRC check as defined in Step above fails, the LRU software sets Harmonizing_PSR_Data_Fault to True, else set  Harmonizing_PSR_Data_Fault to False.

If Harmonizing_PSR_Data_Fault transitions to True, then perform the following:  create a Harmonizing_PSR_Data_Fault entry in the Fault_History_Table_PSR   report Harmonizing Failed to the LRU_2 on STL_Bus:  IVT_Receipt_Envelope=0x0017, IVT_Receipt_Content: Harmonizing_Failed = True. Note: Harmonizing_Failed is defined in Table 1007.
Set the following to False if Harmonizing_PSR_Data_Fault is False.   LRU_Harmonizing_Needed_PIVT   Corrupt_PSR_Harmonizing_CIP_Fault_Init.

If Harmonizing_PSR_Data_Fault is False then perform all of the following assignments:  K_Harmonize_ISM = Harmonize_SFC_PSR   Harmonize_Offset_ISM = Harmonize_Offset_PSR  Lower_Limit_LRU = Lower_Limit_LRU_PSR  Upper_Limit_LRU = Upper_Limit_EBMC_PSR.  Note: These parameters are used in the position control state.  Therefore, one might have to enter the position control state to see the updates.

The LRU_2 EBHA channel commands the LRU to transmit its new Harmonizing parameters including LVDT Harmonizing Gain and LVDT Harmonizing Offset for future Auto-Harmonizing using IVT_Command_ISM and IVT_CmdData_ISM.

If the LRU receives the Harmonizing_and_Configuration_Parameters_Request command below on STL_Bus while Harmonizing_PSR_Data_Fault is False AND Step 34 completed : IVT_Command_ISM = 0x0012 AND IVT_CmdData_ISM = 0x0001, then reply on STL_Bus with the following messages (sequence order insignificant):  IVT_Receipt_Envelope = 0x0011, IVT_Receipt_Content: LRU_Harmonizing_Needed_PIVT = False.  IVT_Receipt_Envelope = 0x0012, IVT_Receipt_Content = Config_LRU_PSR (LRU Harmonizing Location and Asset type)  IVT_Receipt_Envelope = 0x0013, IVT_Receipt_Content = Asset_ID_PSR   IVT_Receipt_Envelope = 0x0014, IVT_Receipt_Content = Harmonizing_SFC_PSR  IVT_Receipt_Envelope = 0x0015, IVT_Receipt_Content = Harmonizing_Offset_PSR  IVT_Receipt_Envelope = 0x0018, IVT_Receipt_Content = Lower_Limit_LRU_PSR  IVT_Receipt_Envelope = 0x0019, IVT_Receipt_Content = Upper_Limit_LRU_PSR  IVT_Receipt_Envelope = 0x0017, IVT_Receipt_Content: Harmonizing_Complete = True Note: All IVT Response Codes and Data IVT formats are defined in Table 1007.
